description: EC daylight-horizon + poor-night WAIT floor replay fixture (PLANNING_ec_daylight_horizon_and_poor_night_floor.md D0). Hand-built 2026-10-03 from a read-only extract of the HA recorder (ssh ha, home-assistant_v2.db opened mode=ro).

provenance.side_entities_join: as-of (last recorder state at or before t)
provenance.t: recorder last_updated of the strategy-sensor row (UTC ISO)
provenance.sun: DERIVED, not recorded: the recorder strips sun.sun next_rising/next_setting. astral Location(lat 30.314635, lon -98.015861, tz America/Chicago), observer_elevation=320 (HA core.config), next event strictly after t, UTC ISO.
provenance.cadence: strategy sensor republishes ~30 s; decisions run every ~5 min (energy_decision_interval=5). Decision ticks are identified by a change in a decision-only attribute (arb_projection_rung0/1, reason, command_trail live_desire, arbitrage_rung/phase, hardware_noncompliance discharge_w_observed/consecutive_ticks); gaps > 450 s are filled with the row nearest anchor + k*300 s. Every rung/phase transition row is therefore kept.
